proposals.before: Dong Zhuo herded the entire population of Luoyang west through the passes while he stayed behind encamped at Bigui Park.
proposals.after: Dong Zhuo herded the entire population of the capital west through the passes while he stayed behind encamped at Bigui Park.
proposals.reason: Chinese 京師 means the capital; the idiomatic rendering invents the place-name Luoyang.

proposals.before: Structures outside the Xueping Gate in Chang’an fell in without apparent cause.
proposals.after: Structures outside the Xuanping Gate in Chang’an fell in without apparent cause.
proposals.reason: Chinese 宣平城門 is Xuanping Gate; idiomatic wrongly reads Xueping.

proposals.before: On bingzi Zhao Qian, former general-in-chief, became minister of education.
proposals.after: On bingzi Zhao Qian, the Former General, became minister of education.
proposals.reason: Chinese 前將軍 is Former General, not general-in-chief (大將軍).

proposals.before: That year Liu Yao met Sun Ce at Qu’e and lost; Sun Ce then took control of Wu east of the river.
proposals.after: That year Inspector of Yang Liu Yao fought Yuan Shu’s general Sun Ce at Qu’e; Yao’s army was routed, and Sun Ce then occupied the lands east of the Yangzi.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic omits Yuan Shu (袁術) present in the Chinese and misrenders 江東 as “Wu east of the river.”

proposals.before: In the sixth month, on yimao, the emperor visited Wenxi.
proposals.after: In the sixth month, on yiwei, the emperor visited Wenxi.
proposals.reason: 乙未 is yiwei, not yimao (乙卯); the sexagenary day is mistranslated.

proposals.before: On gengwu Li Jue and Guo Si overtook the imperial column at Eastern Ford, shattered the escort, and slew Deng Quan, Shisun Rui, Xuan Bo, Miao Si, Wei Jie, Zhu Zhan, and Ju Jun.
proposals.after: On gengwu Li Jue and Guo Si overtook the imperial column at Eastern Stream, shattered the escort, and slew Deng Quan, Shisun Rui, Xuan Bo, Miao Si, Wei Jie, Zhu Zhan, and Ju Jun.
proposals.reason: 東澗 is a stream/ravine (jian), not a ford; “Eastern Ford” mistranslates 澗.

proposals.before: In the spring of the second year at Xu Yuan Shu declared himself emperor.
proposals.after: In the spring of the second year Yuan Shu declared himself emperor.
proposals.reason: Chinese has no 許/Xu here; idiomatic fuses the capital Xu into “Xu Yuan Shu,” inventing a place not in this sentence.

proposals.before: The Wei and Ying rivers burst their banks in the seventh month.
proposals.after: The Wei (洧) and Ying rivers burst their banks in the seventh month.
proposals.reason: Chinese 洧水 is the Wei River written 洧; the idiomatic “Wei” alone is easily confused with the polity Wei in these annals.

proposals.before: Yet here was a man who bore that burden on his back while being driven onward—was this not fate run to its bitter end!
proposals.after: As for the one who to this day bears it on his back and yet hurries on—is this not likewise the end of exhausted fate!
proposals.reason: 負而趨 refers to bearing the tripod while hastening; the idiomatic “driven onward” obscures the active 趨 of the Chinese.

decisions.reason: Although 京師 literally means the capital, the preceding move to Chang'an makes Luoyang the specific city whose population Dong Zhuo forced west. The existing wording is accurate and clearer in context.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 董卓驅徙京師百姓悉西入關

decisions.reason: 宣平 is Xuanping. Xueping is a straightforward place-name mistranscription.
前將軍 is the Former General office, distinct from 大將軍, general-in-chief.
The existing translation omits Yuan Shu's command relationship and distorts 江東. The proposal restores 袁術將 and accurately renders the region east of the Yangzi.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 劉繇與袁術將孫策戰於曲阿，繇軍敗績，孫策遂據江東

decisions.reason: 乙未 is yiwei; yimao would require 乙卯.
澗 denotes a stream or ravine, not a ford. Eastern Stream is the accurate reading of 東澗 here.
The Chinese moves directly from the season and year to Yuan Shu's declaration. The words 'at Xu' are unsupported and fuse awkwardly into his name.
The coordinated noun 'Wei and Ying rivers' already identifies Wei as a river. Adding a one-off parenthetical Chinese character would not correct the translation and would disrupt house style.

decisions.after: Yet here was a man who bore that burden on his back and hurried onward—was this not fate run to its bitter end!
decisions.reason: 趨 is active: the man bears the dynastic burden and hurries onward. The revision keeps the existing idiomatic force while removing the unsupported implication that another agent drove him.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 負而趨者，此亦窮運之歸乎
